POWDER QUARTZ Fine.name: POWDER QUARTZ Fine
POWDER QUARTZ Fine.description: A finely ground form of quartz for its high purity, hardness, and resistance to chemical weathering
POWDER QUARTZ Fine.more_detail:
POWDER QUARTZ Fine is a finely ground form of quartz, one of the most abundant minerals on Earth. It is composed almost entirely of silicon dioxide and is known for its high purity, hardness, and resistance to chemical weathering

Coverage: [10 to 12 square m /25kg ]
Finish: GLOSS
Drying Time: ≈ [6 to 10] hours.
Application: using plastic or steel trowel
